sources.title: Ice Crack 5.wav
sources.author: ecfike
sources.input: Public HQ MP3 preview; reused from Ice Cave source

processing: 58-second stereo PCM16 22050Hz loop. Recorded dungeon air filtered 55–680Hz, with a 75%-speed 45–190Hz rumble layer; combined bed RMS 0.042. Recorded crack slowed to half speed and filtered 70–1100Hz with 230/510ms echoes for distant stone creaks at 9,31,46 seconds, peak 0.12/0.095/0.13. Two-second wrap crossfade. No synthesized audio. Reproducible mix_audio.py retained with evidence.
